source_work: Noah Webster, An American Dictionary of the English Language (1828)
rights_basis: The original 1828 dictionary text is public domain.
transcription_source: Internet Archive full-resolution page scan and OCR text, with existing reviewed Webster headwords used for conservative grammatical and spelling relationships.
selection_method: Reviewed the remaining unresolved lowercase KJV forms occurring two or more times and retained one exact Webster headword plus only transparent grammatical or spelling relationships to available reviewed headwords.
review_method: Verified RANG against the printed 1828 scan. For every lookup relationship, confirmed the target headword exists in approved dictionary data and limited the mapping to an inflection, comparative, superlative, adverb, past tense, participle, plural, or KJV/British spelling form.
